### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) and occurred exactly once in every trace of the later window (200 of 200, mean 1.0 occurrence per trace). [OCC001]
- In the earlier window, A07's only observed successor was A04, and the pair A07→A04 occurred at a distance of one step in all 200 traces; in the later window, A07's observed successor is A01 instead, and the A07→A04 distance moved to two steps in all 200 traces. [DIR002, LAG001]
- In the later window, A01's only observed outgoing transition leads to A04. [DIR001]
- The A01–A04 relation changed from "A04 always without A01" (200 of 200 earlier traces) to "always together, A01 first" (200 of 200 later traces); the A01–A07 relation changed the same way, with A07 executed first. [REL001, REL002]
- Positions are consistent with one activity inserted in the middle of the sequence: A01 sits at mean relative position 0.5 in the later window, while A07 moved slightly earlier (0.40 → 0.33) and A04 slightly later (0.60 → 0.67). [POS001, POS003, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was added as a mandatory step between A07 and A04: in the earlier window every observed trace ran A07 directly followed by A04, while in the later window every trace runs A07 → A01 → A04, with A01 executed once per case. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR002, REL001, REL002, LAG001]

Supporting signs: nine control-flow items qualified where only about 0.04 would be expected by chance in an unchanged process, so the pattern as a whole cannot be explained by random sampling; each item's difference also exceeds those of about 995 in 1,000 random re-splits of the pooled data. The change is shown directly by relational evidence — A07's successor switched from A04 to A01, A01's successor is A04, and the A07→A04 lag grew from one to two steps — and it is consistent across the occurrence, direction, position and relation indicators. [DIR001, DIR002, LAG001, REL001, REL002, OCC001, POS001]

Limitations: all nine items describe one underlying trace-level change, so they are agreeing views of the same difference rather than independent confirmations; and zero participation in the earlier window strictly means only that A01 was not observed then. [OCC001]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out: A01 may have existed earlier under a different label or simply gone unobserved in the earlier sample, rather than being newly introduced; the evidence establishes the structural insertion between A07 and A04 but not whether the activity itself is new. [OCC001]
